description: Brazilian university researchers compile rainfall intensity–duration–frequency equations for 6,550 stations from 370 publications. Mendeley Data supplies station identities, coordinates, rainfall-series periods, equation parameters and references as an Excel workbook and geospatial layers in GeoPackage, shapefile and GeoJSON formats. Separate groups distinguish equations fitted to subdaily observations from those derived by disaggregating daily rainfall maxima. The national collection is freely available under CC BY 4.0 and can supply stormwater or road-drainage design simulations. Differences in record length, original methods and disaggregation assumptions mean direct comparison is limited among stations. Equations should be assessed against local design requirements before use. No directly related catalogue dataset was identified.
